points.title: 早年成长
points.description: 康拉德·阿登纳1876年出生于科隆的一个天主教家庭。他在科隆接受教育，先后就读于科隆的耶稣会学校和弗赖堡大学、慕尼黑大学、波恩大学，学习法律。1906年，阿登纳开始在科隆担任律师，并积极参与当地政治活动。这段时期为他后来的政治生涯奠定了基础，培养了他对地方治理的深刻理解和务实作风。
points.descriptionEn: Konrad Adenauer was born in 1876 in Cologne to a Catholic family. He received his education in Cologne, attending Jesuit schools and studying law at the universities of Freiburg, Munich, and Bonn. In 1906, Adenauer began practicing law in Cologne and became actively involved in local politics. This period laid the foundation for his later political career, developing his deep understanding of local governance and pragmatic approach to politics.

points.title: 科隆市长
points.description: 1917年，阿登纳被任命为科隆市长，开始了长达16年的市长生涯。在他的领导下，科隆在第一次世界大战后迅速重建，他推动了城市基础设施的现代化，包括莱茵河港口的扩建和科隆大教堂的修复。他还积极推动科隆与法国城市的合作，促进莱茵地区的和解。1926年，他成为德国参议院议长，代表德国参与国际事务。然而，1933年纳粹上台后，他被免职并被短暂监禁，结束了他的地方政治生涯。
points.descriptionEn: In 1917, Adenauer was appointed Lord Mayor of Cologne, beginning a 16-year tenure as mayor. Under his leadership, Cologne rapidly rebuilt after World War I, promoting modernization of city infrastructure including expansion of the Rhine port and restoration of the Cologne Cathedral. He actively fostered cooperation between Cologne and French cities, promoting reconciliation in the Rhineland. In 1926, he became President of the Prussian State Council, representing Germany in international affairs. However, with the Nazi rise to power in 1933, he was dismissed from office and briefly imprisoned, ending his local political career.

points.title: 纳粹时期
points.description: 纳粹上台后，阿登纳经历了政治迫害和短暂监禁。尽管他最初对希特勒政权持谨慎态度，但逐渐成为反对者。他多次被盖世太保监视，甚至面临暗杀威胁。1944年，他被卷入7月20日刺杀希特勒的事件，被短暂关押于拉文斯布吕克集中营。这段艰难岁月使阿登纳深刻认识到极权主义的危害，也坚定了他战后重建民主德国的决心。他利用这段时间思考德国的未来，形成了战后政治理念的基础。
points.descriptionEn: After the Nazi seizure of power, Adenauer faced political persecution and brief imprisonment. Although initially cautious toward the Hitler regime, he gradually became an opponent. He was frequently monitored by the Gestapo and faced assassination threats. In 1944, he was implicated in the July 20 plot to assassinate Hitler and briefly imprisoned at Ravensbrück concentration camp. This difficult period made Aden deeply aware of the dangers of totalitarianism and strengthened his determination to rebuild democratic Germany after the war. He used this time to reflect on Germany's future, forming the basis of his post-war political philosophy.

points.title: 重建德国
points.description: 二战结束后，阿登纳积极参与德国的政治重建。1945年，他再次被任命为科隆市长，但不久后因与盟军当局的分歧而辞职。1946年，他参与创建基督教民主联盟(CDU)，并成为该党的领导人。他主张在德国建立民主制度，同时强调与西方国家的合作。1948-1949年，他担任议会委员会主席，主导起草了《基本法》(德国宪法)，为西德奠定了民主基础。在这一阶段，阿登纳确立了其政治理念：亲西方、反共产主义、强调市场经济和联邦制。
points.descriptionEn: After World War II, Adenauer actively participated in Germany's political reconstruction. In 1945, he was again appointed Lord Mayor of Cologne but resigned soon after due to disagreements with the Allied authorities. In 1946, he helped found the Christian Democratic Union (CDU) and became its leader. He advocated for establishing a democratic system in Germany while emphasizing cooperation with Western nations. From 1948-1949, he served as Chairman of the Parliamentary Council, leading the drafting of the Basic Law (German constitution), laying the democratic foundation for West Germany. During this period, Adenauer established his political principles: pro-Western, anti-communist, emphasizing market economy and federalism.

points.title: 联邦总理
points.description: 1949年，73岁的阿登纳当选德意志联邦共和国首任总理，开始了长达14年的执政生涯。在他的领导下，西德实现了经济奇迹(经济复苏)，加入了欧洲煤钢共同体，成为欧洲一体化的推动者。他坚持与西方结盟，使西德加入北约，同时寻求与法国和解，推动法德友谊。1955年，他成功争取西德主权恢复。1961年，柏林墙的修建对他的政策构成挑战，但他仍坚持西方路线。1963年，他因年龄和健康原因辞去总理职务，但继续担任CDU主席直到1966年。他的政策为西德奠定了稳定、繁荣和民主的基础，使德国重新成为国际社会的重要成员。
points.descriptionEn: In 1949, at the age of 73, Adenauer was elected the first Chancellor of the Federal Republic of Germany, beginning a 14-year tenure. Under his leadership, West Germany achieved the 'economic miracle,' joined the European Coal and Steel Community, and became a driving force for European integration. He maintained alliance with the West, bringing West Germany into NATO, while seeking reconciliation with France and promoting Franco-German friendship. In 1955, he successfully secured the restoration of West German sovereignty. The construction of the Berlin Wall in 1961 posed challenges to his policies, but he remained committed to the Western course. In 1963, he resigned as Chancellor due to age and health reasons but continued as CDU chairman until 1966. His policies established a foundation of stability, prosperity, and democracy for West Germany, making Germany a significant member of the international community once again.

supporter.zh: 阿登纳被誉为'德国的拯救者'和'欧洲一体化之父'。支持者认为他凭借非凡的政治远见和坚定意志，带领战败的德国走出废墟，重建民主制度，实现经济繁荣。他坚持与西方结盟的政策使德国摆脱了冷战中的孤立，而他对欧洲一体化的推动则为德国赢得了国际尊重。阿登纳的政治遗产包括稳定的民主制度、社会市场经济模式以及与邻国的和解，这些都成为现代德国的基石。
supporter.en: Adenauer is hailed as 'the savior of Germany' and 'the father of European integration.' Supporters credit him with extraordinary political vision and unwavering will that led defeated Germany from ruins to rebuilding a democratic system and achieving economic prosperity. His policy of maintaining alliance with the West helped Germany avoid isolation during the Cold War, while his promotion of European integration earned Germany international respect. Adenauer's political legacy includes stable democracy, the social market economy model, and reconciliation with neighboring nations—all cornerstones of modern Germany.

critic.zh: 批评者认为阿登纳的政策存在明显局限。他长期担任总理(14年)被视为权力过度集中，压制了党内民主。他对纳粹时期的抵抗不够积极，被指责为'机会主义者'。他的亲西方政策使德国在冷战初期完全依赖美国，缺乏独立外交立场。此外，他对东德的处理方式被批评为过于强硬，阻碍了德国统一。1961年柏林墙修建后，他未能有效应对德国分裂的现实，显示出其政策的局限性。
critic.en: Critics argue that Adenauer's policies had significant limitations. His long chancellorship (14 years) was seen as excessive concentration of power, suppressing intra-party democracy. His resistance to the Nazi regime was deemed insufficient, leading to accusations of being an 'opportunist.' His pro-Western policy made Germany completely dependent on the US in the early Cold War, lacking independent diplomatic stance. Additionally, his approach to East Germany was criticized as too rigid, hindering German unification. After the Berlin Wall's construction in 1961, he failed to effectively address the reality of Germany's division, revealing limitations in his policies.

objective.zh: 历史学界普遍认为阿登纳是战后德国最具影响力的政治家之一。他成功地将战败的德国重新纳入国际社会，建立了稳定的民主制度。在流行文化中，阿登纳常被塑造为'务实的理想主义者'形象，既坚持原则又灵活务实。他的政治理念——社会市场经济、联邦制和欧洲一体化——深刻影响了现代德国的发展轨迹。尽管存在争议，但阿登纳的政策为德国战后重建奠定了基础，使德国从战败国转变为欧洲的领导者，这一历史成就得到广泛认可。
objective.en: Historiography generally regards Adenauer as one of the most influential post-war German politicians. He successfully reintegrated defeated Germany into the international community and established a stable democratic system. In popular culture, Adenauer is often portrayed as a 'pragmatic idealist,' both principled and flexible. His political concepts—the social market economy, federalism, and European integration—profoundly influenced the trajectory of modern Germany. Despite controversies, Adenauer's policies laid the foundation for Germany's post-war reconstruction, transforming it from a defeated nation to a European leader, an achievement widely recognized in history.

self.zh: 我们德国人必须学会，除了德国的利益外，还要考虑欧洲的利益。
self.en: We Germans must learn to consider not only German interests, but also European interests.

others.zh: 阿登纳是一位伟大的政治家，他不仅重建了德国，还重新定义了德国在欧洲和世界中的位置。
others.en: Adenauer was a great statesman who not only rebuilt Germany but also redefined Germany's place in Europe and the world.
